description: Invite a club's members, or a tour's riders, by email, from a list the organiser gives (a CSV, a spreadsheet's text, or names and addresses typed in): for a club or organiser page the signed-in person runs (page on Windline, club on RunFast) or a published tour of theirs (event). Each person gets one email from livedot: "<club> added you as a member" (or "<organiser> added you to <tour>") with Confirm; nobody joins until they confirm, and nobody is invited twice. The first call (without confirm) only reads the list and returns who would be invited and who's skipped (listed twice, invited before, unsubscribed, no usable email): show the organiser that, get a yes, then call again with confirm: true. A day's limit: 500 for club admins and managers, 50 for a tour's organiser, 20 for an account under a week old; the preview says how many go today.

club.description: RunFast: the club address they manage (runfast.tech/c/<address>).

confirm.description: true only after the organiser said yes to the preview this tool returned.

csv.description: The list as the organiser gave it: a CSV or spreadsheet's text (any delimiter, with or without a header row), up to 2,000 people.

csv_file.description: The CSV or spreadsheet the organiser attached (ChatGPT passes it here); or pass its text as csv.

file_name.description: Its name, if known (the route's name; never an event's).

event.description: A published Windline tour of theirs, by its id from list_my_events.

page.description: Windline: the club page address they run (livedot.me/<address> or windline.tech/c/<address>).

people.description: Or the people as a list: [{ name, email }].

name: invite_members

outputSchema.description: Who would get an invite (preview), or who got one.

app.description: The account's app: windline or runfast.

error.description: When the call failed: what went wrong, in words for the user.

failed.description: How many couldn't be sent just now.

invalid.description: Rows without a usable email (the first 10).

message.description: When view is "none": what to tell the user (no match, not live yet, a question back).

people.description: The first 25 who'd get an invite: { name, email }.

signup.description: Without a sign-in: { label, url } to make a free Windline or RunFast account (?ref=mcp).

skipped.description: Skipped: { invalid, duplicate, already, unsubscribed, over_limit }.

sponsor_line.description: The line every answer ends with: who brings livedot's live tracking free.

target.description: The club or tour: { kind, name, url }.

to_send.description: How many would be (or were) invited.

view.description: What this answer is; "none" when there is nothing to show (see message).

title: Invite members by email
